evidence.paraphrase: Jim is pained by seeing Rosie drunk.

evidence.quote:
By one means and another they made their way into the Gray Dome country
and Jim built a cabin there.
evidence.paraphrase: The couple relocates to a new place and starts a new life.

evidence.quote: Fifteen years later, Rosie Briggs stood in the door of it
evidence.paraphrase: The narrative jumps ahead fifteen years.

evidence.quote:
in the midst of cleanness and
silence unbroken since that old rocky backbone of the continent thrust
itself up into the sun, she had risen slowly out of the shards of the
life of Captain Mac and come, late but surely, into her heritage of
womanliness and dignity.
evidence.paraphrase: Rosie has transformed over the years into a dignified woman.

evidence.quote:
And when it cut across the stillness like
the whistle of a locomotive it struck her cold. It chilled the core of
her spirit
evidence.paraphrase: Rosie feels dread when she realizes Jim has struck ore.

evidence.quote:
Struck it, by thunder! Two hundred dollars to the ton, if it\u2019s worth a
cent!
evidence.paraphrase: Jim announces he has struck a valuable ore vein.

evidence.quote:
Whatever
else it meant, it meant the end of this; the beginning of uncertainty.
evidence.paraphrase: Rosie anticipates the wealth will end their stable life.

evidence.quote:
They always left the women they had picked up
when they were poor. Especially dance hall women. Even when they were
their wives.
evidence.paraphrase: Rosie reasons that newly rich miners abandon the poor women who supported them.

evidence.quote:
A knife seemed to unfold inside of Rosie. It cut her song off in the
middle of the line and brought her upright in her chair with a gasp.
evidence.paraphrase: Rosie reacts with sudden dread to smelling perfume on Jim's coat.

evidence.quote:
The current of her life had swept past its one clean
tranquil place and was swirling along muddied and normal.
evidence.paraphrase: Rosie feels her old troubled self returning.

evidence.quote:
her rouged cheeks and scarlet
lips and half-bared heaving breasts contrasted strangely with her
honest eyes.
evidence.paraphrase: Rosie's dance-hall appearance contrasts with her honest character.
